entries.value: "`bsc rf` — DEFENSIVE RF monitoring: detect radio jamming and RF denial-of-service against 2.4/5 GHz WiFi from a commodity adapter. Reads the radio's own telemetry (nl80211 survey occupancy, monitor-mode radiotap frame statistics) and fuses several weak signals into a verdict that carries its evidence. Nothing here transmits — there is no injection, no deauth and no active probing path, and a test asserts it."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The radio is plugged into the monitor Pi, so the tool must run THERE — and the
# unified `bsc` carries bundled DuckDB against a device with 1.1 GB free on its
# SD card. Same precedent as bsc-lan; tests/lean.rs keeps it honest.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared CLI scaffold (#1762): CmdDoc help catalog + the emit/absent-marker conventions every
# Proc-macro only: no runtime weight, and tests/lean.rs still pins the closure.
